fiscal_measures.description: SPLOST, E-SPLOST, LOST and other measures remain separate.

financial_baseline.description: Entity-keyed county, city and school records with latest audited period separated from current public signals.

operating_revenue.description: LOST, property tax and other operating-revenue signals kept separate from capital measures.

enterprise_funds.description: Proprietary activity remains separate from ordinary General Fund revenue.

recent_signals.description: Dated official, state, local-reporting or community-source items with evidence labels.

referendum_discovery.description: Ballotpedia discovery/context and official-validation status remain separate.

entity_cache.description: Cache keys combine entity, document type, fiscal period/date and source URL.

community_conditions.description: Entity-keyed active-priority records conforming to community_conditions.schema.json and using only VERIFIED, REPORTED, INFERENCE, or RESEARCH NEEDED.

search_lane_results.description: Minimum-search-set coverage with attempted, populated, cached and unresolved lanes.

scores.description: Optional synthetic/regression dimensions only; real-community output does not force numeric scores.
